description: Discover which step-by-step replacement guides exist (battery, SSD, RAM, keyboard, fan, etc.), paraphrased from official service manuals and not bench-tested. Use it to find guide slugs (summaries only, no steps), then call get_repair_guide to read the steps; call get_repair_guide directly if you already know the slug. For parts rather than procedures use get_model_parts. Filter by model (slug or name; ambiguous names return candidates), component and/or query; with no arguments it lists every guide. Also lists not-yet-covered topics. An unknown model returns an error.

component.description: Optional component, e.g. battery, ssd, ram, keyboard, fan, speakers

model.description: Optional model slug or name, e.g. hp-elitebook-840-g6 or "HP EliteBook 840 G6"

query.description: Optional free-text filter; every word must appear in the guide title, slug or model name

name: find_repair_guides

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Find repair guides
